what: A project's add-ons for Sova-run chats (merge-queue, release, review, request, project-setup) moved from .sova/playbooks/<id> to .sova/playbook-config/<id>; a project with only the old folder is read there, and the old defaults are still recognised.

Sova's six own playbooks moved from playbooks/<id> to system-playbooks/<id>; a chat started before the move names the old folder in its first message: it keeps project_verbs (the folder is read at the new place) and its next turn is told the new folder.
